en.t: He gave it a pull with his hand, and there was a response.

units.source_text: 虽然不敢立刻相信，但绳索真的不动了。

en.t: Although he could not bring himself to believe it at once, the rope really had stopped moving.

units.source_text: 他再用拉着绳索的手臂发力……

en.t: He put strength once more into the arm that was pulling the rope...

units.source_text: 幻灭的瞬间难道就在眼前吗，他拉开架势等待着……

en.t: Was the moment of disillusion right before his eyes? He braced himself and waited...
But there was no room left for doubt.

units.source_text: 剪刀钩子死死地咬住了草包，怎么这样走运！

en.t: The scissor hook had bitten tightly into the straw bag. What incredible luck!
...It was truly amazing; it had actually caught!

units.source_text: ……照这样子下去，再往前一定更顺利！

en.t: ...If things kept going like this, everything ahead was bound to go even more smoothly!
